notes: C12 changed during the build: the email preview now follows the page theme rather than staying light, at the user's direction. renderWeekly gained a theme param; the Monday send stays light.
The scoped :global(.dark) selector did not survive this build's PostCSS pipeline, so theme selection moved to useColorMode in the component.

Two self-caught defects: the demo greeted anonymous visitors with the empty state (fixed by making login nullable), and the trending button said 'See last Monday's' while the preview renders the current week (relabelled).
